provenance.scope: All 515 listed sub-*/ses-*/eeg/*.set files; urevent only inspected for this audit
provenance.method: Identify CELL definitions with PRAC or TRAIN in label (case insensitive); match their numeric mffkey_cel identifiers against bgin, Stm+ and TRSP records; inspect other practice/training labels, SESS counts and non-increasing TRSP trial-number steps.
provenance.limitations: No claim about undocumented practice coding or whether practice was performed before recording/export. No exclusions applied.
